phase: Institution-axis candidate comparison. Three prompts identical except for how institutions are treated; one seed, the same 96 known day conditions, gate active.
primary: All 96 cells once per candidate with frozen source and contracts. First-pass judging is execution quality only: contract pass, gate exclusions, accounting and physical checks, unmet-need handling. No candidate is chosen for matching a measured sign.
limitations: Prompts are unchanged from the previous round. This run tests the pipeline, not a new prompt candidate.
Explicit synthetic work/school schedules, not observed historical roles.
Only detergent inventory and optional laundry need tracked; no whole household demand claim.
One day, 12 citizens, 1 replicate. No population significance and no empirical policy-effect claim.
A new seed draws new plans; this is not a re-scoring of the previous run's rows.
Three candidates differ on one axis only; a difference elsewhere would break attribution.
Answer-key comparison is deliberately out of scope here and waits for estimand alignment.
preflight: 277 unit checks passed including 6 new resource-gate regressions. Source, v25 and asset_transaction_v7 unchanged from the previous round.
selection: Pre-registered closed candidate set v25/v26/v27 (experiments/v3/prompt_v3.md). v27 is the lower bound: if v26 does not beat it, the added sentences did no work. Seed fixed before v2 results were seen.
